information: This is the springtime competition at UC Berkeley, run by the Berkeley Cube Club! **Travel:** Parking is hard to find at and around UC Berkeley. Plan to arrive early if driving so that you have time to find a spot -- you might need to park some distance away and walk. Buses and BART are a good alternative (the Downtown Berkeley BART station is near the west end of campus). **Please be at least 15 minutes early to your first event of each day.**
